instructions.question: What overall polarity does this French tweet convey about the situation, event or topic it reports (often ecology, energy, climate), reading its wording at face value?
instructions.rule: Positive needs a good outcome or concrete action: an actor launching, inaugurating, building, deploying, voting for, investing in, backing or betting on a project; success, approval, awards, reinforced support, celebration, praise or advocacy (ironic praise counts literally). Negative needs harm, threat, decline, suspension, scandal, opposition, criticism or insult. Neutral covers descriptions of what a technology or place is, statistics, forecasts and planned tests, generic slogans, puns, banter, anecdotes, agendas and meeting notices.

neutral.what: Information without a framed outcome: what a technology or place is, data, forecasts, tests, agendas, meetings, slogans, puns, chit-chat.
examples: Innovation : des tuiles transparentes pour capter l'énergie solaire http @user #energie (Innovation: transparent tiles to capture solar energy)
Un dispositif de stockage de l'#énergie solaire va être testé à #Lausanne #DD  http (A solar energy storage device will be tested in Lausanne)
L'Ademe publie l'édition 2014 des chiffres-clés des #déchets (Ademe publishes the 2014 key figures on waste)
"On peut vendre du vent, regarde les éoliennes" (You can sell wind, look at wind turbines)
neutral.cues: publie (publishes), réunion (meeting), va être testé (will be tested), pourrait (could), au coeur de (at the heart of), à la pointe (leading), ?, chiffres (figures), puns on vent (wind)
neutral.not_for: An actor's concrete launch, investment or success is positive; harm or suspension is negative.

positive.what: Concrete green actions by an actor, achievements, approvals, awards, reinforced support, protections, celebrations, praise, thanks, enthusiasm, advocacy, or literal praise used ironically.
examples: Areva : Les 80 éoliennes du parc de Global Tech I installées avec succès http (Areva: the 80 turbines of the Global Tech I park successfully installed)
Biocarburant : inauguration de la plateforme technologique de prétraitement de la biomasse http (Biofuel: inauguration of the biomass pretreatment technology platform)
A contre-courant du reste de la Suisse, Genève mise sur la géothermie http (Against the rest of Switzerland, Geneva bets on geothermal energy)
Au Testet, la police stimule la croissance en coupant les arbres (At Testet, police stimulate growth by cutting trees)
positive.cues: lance (launches), inauguration, mise sur (bets on), construire (build), déploiement (deployment), vote, opérationnel (operational), investissement (investment), avec succès (successfully), renforcées (reinforced), applaudissent (applaud), lauréat (winner), bravo, merci
positive.not_for: Descriptions of what an invention is, statistics, forecasts and slogans are neutral.

negative.what: Threats, damage, deaths, decline, suspensions, scandals, opposition, criticism, anger or insults.
examples: Le manchot empereur victime du réchauffement climatique http (The emperor penguin, victim of global warming)
Suspension sine die de l'#ecotaxe http (Indefinite suspension of the ecotax)
@user Les éoliennes défigurent nos jolies campagnes. (Wind turbines disfigure our countryside.)
negative.cues: menacée (threatened), victime (victim), péril, suspension, scandale, enfer (hell), opposition, craintes (fears), détruit (destroyed), inutile (useless)
negative.not_for: Ironic praise phrased positively is positive; harmless jokes are neutral.
